## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`assist/source/useSortedEnumMembers`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- Sources: 
  - Inspired from [`@graphql-eslint/alphabetize`](https://the-guild.dev/graphql/eslint/rules/alphabetize)

## How to enable in your editor
<EditorAction includeFixAll action="source.action.useSortedEnumMembers.biome" />
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedEnumMembers": "on"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Sort the members of an enum in natural order.

Enforce a consistent natural sort order for GraphQL enum values.

Keeping enum values sorted makes schema definitions easier to review and maintain,
especially as enums grow over time.

Members are sorted in a [Natural order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_sort_order),
meaning that uppercase letters come before lowercase letters (e.g. `A` < `a` < `B` < `b`)
and numbers are compared to their numerical value (e.g. `9` < `10`).

## Examples

### Invalid

```graphql
enum Role {
  SUPER_ADMIN
  ADMIN
  USER
  GOD
}
```
